title: Validate age before calculating
prompt: A user enters an age from 0 through 130. Return next year’s age; reject every other value with std::invalid_argument before doing arithmetic. The driver catches the error.
hints: Reject a bad input before computing the return value.
explanation: The function owns validation. The driver owns terminal input and printing. A throw transfers control to the driver’s catch block.
chapterTitle: Writing, Compiling, and Running Your First C++ Programs
